purpose: Export actual historical MTF states for manual recognition labelling before any profitability screen.

data_contract.source: Binance Vision USD-M Futures public archives

evaluation_contract.evaluation_clock: every available 15m bar open inside the scan interval
evaluation_contract.include_when: POI exists or H1 raid, H1 VC or 5m BOS exists
evaluation_contract.sampling: first four snapshots chronologically per symbol, side and setup_state

forbidden_fields: any candle after the evaluation timestamp except the next 15m open value used as the planned execution price
success_definition: The workflow completes and produces deterministic no-PnL candidate states. This run cannot pass or fail a trading edge gate.
next_action: Review state distribution and convert a balanced subset into frozen human-labelled recognition cases. Do not tune for PnL.
